On this observation date the fictional participant completed a quiet reading session and described feeling rested after an early night. The recorded walk lasted 42 minutes. Estimated sleep was 5.75 hours, and the self-reported energy score was 5 out of 10. The notebook contains 4 observations for this day, with 1 questions left for a future discussion.
